$comment: Single source of truth for business and legal details. Values in [square brackets] are placeholders and MUST be replaced before launch. Run `npm run check:business` to list any that remain. After editing, run `npm run build:legal` to regenerate the policies in the mobile app and website.
tagline: Manage your AI agents from your phone.
entityType: [e.g. private limited company / LLC / sole trader]
governingLaw: [e.g. the laws of England and Wales]
jurisdictionCourts: [e.g. the courts of England and Wales]
euRepresentative: [EU Art. 27 representative name and address, or 'Not appointed']
ukRepresentative: [UK representative name and address, or 'Not appointed']
hostingProvider: Replit, Inc. (website and privacy-request service hosting)
emailProvider: [YOUR EMAIL DELIVERY PROVIDER, e.g. your SMTP host]

pricing.appPrice: Free, with an optional Crewdeck Pro subscription
pricing.summary: Crewdeck is free to download and use with up to 3 agents. Crewdeck Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription that unlocks unlimited agents and the Pro template library. There are no ads and no hidden fees. Separately, you pay your AI provider (Anthropic) directly for API usage, at the rates they publish.
pricing.referencePrices: US$4.99 per month or US$39.99 per year (prices in other countries are set by the App Store and Google Play and shown in the app before you buy)

$transferNote: When the business is sold, the buyer replaces every legal/business field here (see docs/ownership-transfer). Keep productIds and the app bundle IDs unchanged so existing subscribers keep their subscriptions.
